facts.fact: An editorial says communes had always done local tax collection manually, never digitising their financial services, and that direct communal taxes such as stamps, parking and market rents could still usefully be digitised in future.

systems.system: Impot General Synthetique collected by the tax administration
systems.owner: Direction Generale des Impots, for the communes

facts.fact: An editorial says the tax directorate has for several years dematerialised all its procedures so that tax declaration and payment are made online, now including the local taxes unified as the Impot General Synthetique.
